focus.warn: Programs are closed without asking – unsaved work in those programs is lost.

computer.name: Display name
computer.hint: Orbit Agent must be installed on the computer. The MAC address is learned automatically the first time the computer is online.
discover.title: Find student computers
discover.text: Searches your local network for computers running Orbit Agent. Computers that trust your teacher key are pre-selected.
discover.deep: Deep scan (slower – use when nothing is found)
discover.scanning: Scanning all addresses of your network… this takes a few seconds
discover.none: No Orbit Agents found. Check that the agent is installed, the computers are on the same network and try the deep scan.
discover.manualText: Enter a computer name or IP address, for example when the computer is in another network.
setup.title: Set up student computers
setup.text: Every student computer needs Orbit Agent once. The setup package already contains your public teacher key.
setup.s1: Download the setup package and copy it to the student computer (USB stick or network share).
setup.s2: Unzip it and double-click Install-Orbit-Agent.cmd, confirm the administrator prompt.
setup.s3: Done – the computer appears when you search the network.
setup.noAgent: OrbitAgent.exe was not found next to OrbitMaster.exe – the package will only contain the key file. Put OrbitAgent.exe into the package yourself.
setup.silent: Mass deployment (GPO, Intune, scripts – run as administrator):
inbox.emptyText: Students can send you a message from the Orbit icon in their system tray.
inbox.handsText: Oldest first. Students raise their hand from the tray icon or with Ctrl+Alt+H.
viewer.typeText: This text is typed on the student computer:
viewer.ctlDisabled: Remote control is disabled on this computer
settings.languageHint: More languages: put a language file into the lang folder (see Help).
settings.soundsHint: Play a sound when a hand is raised or a message arrives
settings.activityHint: Show the active program and idle time on every tile
settings.confirmPowerHint: Ask before restarting, shutting down or logging off
settings.performanceHint: Lower values use less network bandwidth. Orbit only transfers the parts of a screen that change.
settings.thumbIntervalHint: How often the room overview updates
settings.viewQualityHint: JPEG quality of live view / control
settings.demoFpsHint: Use 5–10 on slow networks or with many computers
settings.lockHint: Default text on locked screens. Leave empty for the built-in text in the student's language.
settings.favoritesHint: Websites and programs offered in the Website and Run dialogs.
key.title: Teacher key
key.text: Student computers only accept commands from Orbit Masters that own this key. Share the public key (OPK1-…) freely – it is in the setup package. The secret part never leaves this computer unless you export it.
key.backupWarn: The secret key gives full control over all student computers that trust it. Only show it to copy it to another teacher computer or into a password manager.
key.backupText: Keep this secret! Anyone with this key can control the student computers. Import it on another teacher computer with "Import secret key".
key.importText: Paste a secret key (OTK1-…) exported on another teacher computer. Both teacher computers can then control the same student computers.
key.regenWarn: All student computers will reject this Orbit Master until you install the new setup package on them. Continue?
key.regenerated: New key created – update the student computers
custom.title: Custom actions
custom.text: Add your own buttons to the "More" menu and the command palette, e.g. start a learning app or open your school's website.
custom.name: Name
api.title: Automation API
api.text: Scripts and other programs on this computer can control Orbit Master through a local REST API (127.0.0.1 only). See the guide for all endpoints.
about.title: About
about.quitText: Running demos stop. Locked computers stay locked until you unlock them again.
pal.placeholder: Type a command, room or computer…
onb.title: Welcome
onb.welcomeText: See every screen in your classroom, present, lock, help and ask questions – fast and simple. First, choose your language.
onb.how1: Orbit Master (this program) runs on the teacher computer.
onb.how2: Orbit Agent runs on each student computer. Install it once with the setup package – it contains your teacher key.
onb.how3: Search the network and add the computers to a room. That's it!
onb.security: Connections are encrypted (TLS) and student computers only obey the teacher key in their setup package. Students always see a notice when their screen is viewed or controlled.
onb.findText: When the agents are installed, Orbit finds them on the network automatically.
err.notTrusted: this computer trusts a different teacher key – reinstall it with your setup package
err.timeout: no answer (switched off or blocked by a firewall?)
err.noHost: computer name not found – try the IP address
err.oldAgent: the agent is too old for this action – update it
err.onlyHttp: only http:// and https:// addresses are allowed
err.screen: screen not available (lock screen or admin prompt)
err.cert: security check failed – the agent's certificate changed
